# TSMP Codec Luma4 0.0.3

Luma4 leaves beta with support for stable TSMP Core 0.2.0 in both ordinary Unity and VRChat.

## Changes

- Include the shader include path fixes from 0.0.3-beta.2 for local UPM package layouts. Thanks to @AYANO-TFT for PR #1.
- Include the SDK-neutral codec prefab and package-based SDK detection from 0.0.3-beta.3. Ordinary Unity and VRChat use the same automatic Core Controller setup.
- Update the UPM dependency to Core 0.2.0 and the VPM dependency to Core 0.2.0 or newer.
- Regenerate the bundled Udon program and field metadata for Core 0.2.0's compact encoder query response, retaining the existing asset GUIDs.
- Update English, Korean and Japanese requirements and installation instructions. VRCSDK/UdonSharp is optional for ordinary Unity.

Codec ID, C# codec logic, shader logic and wire format are unchanged from 0.0.3-beta.3.

## Installation

- VRChat: add https://vpm.kiba.red/ to VCC, then install or update TSMP Core and TSMP Codec Luma4. The VRChat Worlds dependency remains 3.9.0 or newer.
- Ordinary Unity: install Core 0.2.0 and this package through UPM's **Add package from disk**. No VRCSDK/UdonSharp installation is required.
- Use Core's `Samples/TSMPController.prefab`, then select Luma4 in the Setup Codec tab. Components and bindings are prepared automatically.
- Allow Unity and UdonSharp to recompile after updating.

## Validation

Verified with Core 0.2.0, Unity 2022.3.22f1 and an RTX 4090 using Direct3D11:

- Actual GPU encode/decode loopback without VRCSDK in the Unity Editor and a built Windows x64 Mono Player.
- Transform and humanoid motion, Component int/Unicode fields, repeated/cross-stream RPCs and blank input rejection.
- Full Udon client compilation with Worlds 3.10.4-beta.2 and bundled UdonSharp, plus configuration and selected VM regressions.

The Player build completed with zero errors and one existing Core SampleBlockLuma shader warning. Managed stripping was disabled. Live VRChat playback, SDK world build and IL2CPP were not performed for this release. Detailed evidence and reproduction steps are in `Validation~/v0.0.3.md`.
